about: Sealed product prices by set code. Each product: n name, id TCGplayer product id (page: https://www.tcgplayer.com/product/<id>), low TCGplayer's lowest current listing (an asking price), mkt TCGplayer's market price (recent sales), ck Card Kingdom [page path after https://www.cardkingdom.com/, retail price, number in stock], list Wizards' list price (hand-entered, tools/sealed_list.json), case 1 for a case of several. US dollars, without shipping or tax. checked is the day the stores were last read. Built by tools/build_sealed.py; don't edit by hand.
